'''Scanner goggles''' were a type of [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] which provided users with enhanced vision in darkness. They were available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
